hypotheses.justification: OrderedSub already implies addition is monotone. For fixed b, `tsub_le_iff_right` gives `(a - b ≤ c) ↔ (a ≤ c + b)`. If c ≤ d, first use the equivalence to get `(c + b) - b ≤ c`, then transitivity gives `(c + b) - b ≤ d`, and the equivalence yields `c + b ≤ d + b`. Thus addition is monotone on the right; commutativity gives monotonicity on the left. This supplies the needed `AddLeftMono α` locally, so the theorem can be proved without taking it as an argument.
